section: Iterate - feature: smoke unit 2 marker check
title: Throwaway smoke check for docs/_smoke/unit-2.md (PR #860 campaign)
context: Campaign smoke-860-20261009 needs a real, tested change per unit to exercise the sub-iterate runner end to end (PR #860). Never merged.
decision: Add stdlib scripts/_smoke_check.py (exit 0 iff the marker is a readable UTF-8 file with visible text after dropping Unicode Cf chars), the marker doc, and 18 tests in shared/tests (no repo-root tests/ root exists; one-test-root rule).
consequences: Nothing permanent: no gate, hook or caller invokes the script and the branch is discarded. Test location deviates from the spec's tests/ path, recorded in the ADR file.
rationale: Smallest change that still gives the runner a collected test to verify; all internal and external reviews approved or were dispositioned.
rejected: Wiring the check into verify_local.py as a gate; a marker-only change with no test.
